composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a, "BILGE SYSTEM") serves two distinct equipment groups: (1) the MAIN BILGE PUMP (motor top-right, fed via F3 60A/SW8/SO6 solenoid, with local pump switch, main-panel switch S13, and ONYX remote path) — matches established node 520-main-bilge-pump and is consistent with the prior engineer red-pen control_loop fact for this same drawing; (2) the five motorised BILGE VALVES (OPEN/CLOSE actuated, fed from Q13 10A via relays Re1-Re5) which control ENG. ROOM BILGE routing to five zones — PORT LAZARETTE, STBD LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG. ROOM, FWD, and SAIL LOCKER bilge lines — matching node 520-bilge-valves. The MAIN PANEL / PLUG C / PLUG D / PC CARD block is shared status/command infrastructure for both (indicator lamps S20-S24 for valve position, S13 for pump run) and is treated as infrastructure of the main panel (641-vessel-control-panel), not a separate equipment node, per the bus/panel ownership rule.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The pump motor labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' is fed via F3 60A / SW8 / SO6 and locally switched; this matches the previously-established multi-switch activation control_loop fact recorded against 520-main-bilge-pump from this same drawing (GM-114a), confirming node identity.

functions.label: Main bilge pump run circuit
functions.what_it_does: Runs the main bilge pump motor to discharge bilge water overboard; the pump can be commanded from multiple locations feeding one solenoid contactor coil.

flow_scenarios.path: 24V service battery (+24V SERVICE BAT.) -> fuse F3 60A -> SW8 -> solenoid coil SO6 -> pump motor M energised when coil closes; local pump switch (T/S S terminals 13/14/15) can close the loop directly
MAIN PANEL switch S13 (BILGE PUMP SW) via PLUG C pins 6/7 -> closes coil circuit -> pump runs; indicator lamp on S13 shows pump-run status
ONYX remote command via cable/tap 'to ONYX' (XA11 pin 32, per prior engineer trace) -> closes relay Re6 (T/S C terminal 50) -> completes coil circuit -> pump runs

key_components: main panel switch S13 with indicator lamp
functions.dry_data: 24V DC circuit; F3 60A fuse; SO6 solenoid coil actuates contactor for pump motor M
functions.sheet_region: top-left (SW8/SO6/F3) and top-right (pump motor M); main panel PLUG C bottom-right for S13

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: All five OPEN/CLOSE motorised valve rows (fed from breaker Q13 'BILGE VALVES' 10A via relays Re1-Re5) are labelled 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' and route to five named bilge zones — matching the established 520-bilge-valves node and its BOM (Burkert electric actuators) fact.

functions.label: Port Lazarette bilge valve (Re1)
functions.what_it_does: Opens/closes the motorised bilge valve routing the Port Lazarette bilge line into the common eng. room bilge suction/discharge manifold.

flow_scenarios.path: valve position holds last commanded state; PORT LAZARETTE BILGE switch (BILGE SW, NO contact, measured) reports position to T/S B / XA40 status taps
Q13 10A (BILGE VALVES) -> T/S B terminal 8 -> Re1 coil energised -> Re1 NO contact closes -> OPEN line (T/S C terminals 7/8) drives valve motor open
same supply and relay path -> CLOSE line (T/S C terminals 7/8 pair) drives valve motor closed

valve position switch (BILGE SW) taps to XA40 terminals 14/12 (measured STATUS, no coil on net) -> to monitoring, and separately to main-panel PC CARD open/closed lamps for LAZARETTE BILGE (circleX/circleDot pair)

key_components: position switch BILGE SW (NO, measured) for Port Laz. bilge
functions.dry_data: 24V DC; fed from Q13 10A via terminal strip T/S B/C; valve motor M with [2]/[3] terminal pair

functions.label: Stbd Lazarette / Aft bilge valve (Re2)
functions.what_it_does: Opens/closes the motorised bilge valve routing the STBD Lazarette and AFT bilge lines into the eng. room bilge manifold.

flow_scenarios.path: Q13 10A -> T/S B terminal 9 -> Re2 coil energised (NO contact, measured) -> OPEN/CLOSE lines (terminals 16-23) drive valve motor
STBD LAZARETTE BILGE / AFT BILGE position switches (BILGE SW) -> XA40 terminal 16 (measured STATUS) -> to monitoring

key_components: BILGE SW position switches (STBD Laz., Aft)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC; fed from Q13 10A via T/S B/C terminals 9, 16-23

functions.label: Engine Room bilge valve (Re3)
functions.what_it_does: Opens/closes the motorised bilge valve for the ENG. ROOM BILGE line itself.

flow_scenarios.path: Q13 10A -> T/S B terminal 10 -> Re3 coil energised (NO contact, measured) -> OPEN/CLOSE lines (terminals 24-31) drive valve motor
ENG. ROOM BILGE position switch (BILGE SW) -> XA10 terminal 06 (measured STATUS) -> to monitoring

key_components: relay Re3 (NO contact, coil measured; note contact-state table also shows one Re3-contact reading as NC — flagged below)
BILGE SW eng. room position switch
functions.dry_data: 24V DC; fed from Q13 10A via T/S B/C terminals 10, 24-31

functions.label: FWD bilge valve (Re4)
functions.what_it_does: Opens/closes the motorised bilge valve for the FWD BILGE line.

flow_scenarios.path: Q13 10A -> T/S B terminal 11 -> Re4 coil energised (NO contact, measured) -> OPEN/CLOSE lines (terminals 32-39) drive valve motor
FWD BILGE position switch (BILGE SW) -> XA10 terminal 04 (measured STATUS) -> to monitoring

functions.dry_data: 24V DC; fed from Q13 10A via T/S B/C terminals 11, 32-39

functions.label: Sail Locker bilge valve (Re5)
functions.what_it_does: Opens/closes the motorised bilge valve for the SAIL LOCKER bilge line.

flow_scenarios.path: Q13 10A -> T/S B terminal 12 -> Re5 coil energised (NO contact, measured) -> OPEN/CLOSE lines (terminals 40-47) drive valve motor
SAIL LOCKER position switch (BILGE SW) reports on shared T/S C net; no distinct XA tap number identified in the netlist for this valve

key_components: BILGE SW sail locker position switch
functions.dry_data: 24V DC; fed from Q13 10A via T/S B/C terminals 12, 40-47

infrastructure.system_name: Main Panel / PLUG C / PLUG D / PC Card (bilge status & command distribution)
facts: S20-S24 are main-panel switches reporting/commanding LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG. ROOM, FWD, SAIL LOCKER bilge status; S13 is the main-panel bilge pump switch with indicator lamp.
PLUG C carries these signals (pins [1]-[7]) plus an AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD connector (pins [8]-[12]) to the MAIN PANEL PC CARD.

PLUG D (pins 1-12) carries the same signal set redundantly into the MAIN PANEL PC CARD, which drives open/closed indicator pairs (circleX=open, circleDot=closed) per zone (LAZARETTE BILGE, AFT BILGE, ENG. ROOM BILGE, FWD BILGE, SAIL LOCKER) via a diode array off the +24V bus.
PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE module taps into PLUG C lines [8]-[12] alongside the AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD — its own supply/role is not detailed on this sheet.
F2 200A fuse and +24V SERVICE BAT. feed the vertical bus supplying T/S B / Q13 / F3 branches.

good_to_have: F3 60A fuse rating on main bilge pump supply — value visible on drawing.
F2 200A fuse rating on the +24V service battery bus — value visible on drawing.
Q13 10A breaker rating for BILGE VALVES supply — value visible on drawing.
Exact Burkert actuator part numbers on the five bilge valves — available at inspection / BOM (established fact).
uncertainties: Re3's contact state shows a conflict in the measurement: the general relay table records relay_contact (coil Re3) as NO (confirmed by symbol+wiring), but a separate 'Re3-contact' reading elsewhere records NC on net12. This inversion changes whether the ENG. ROOM bilge valve function is OFF-until-energised or ON-until-energised — needs engineer confirmation.

Correspondence between the five main-panel switches S20-S24 (LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG. ROOM, FWD, SAIL LOCKER BILGE) and the five relay/valve rows Re1-Re5 is NOT established by a measured net pairing in the given netlist (labels sit on separate nets net58-net61/net64) — do not assume S20->Re1, S21->Re2 etc. by position; this is an unresolved 1:1 mapping.

PORT LAZARETTE BILGE label and BILGE SW for STBD LAZARETTE BILGE are UNBOUND/only partially bound in the netlist — the exact relay (Re1 vs Re2) each of the two Lazarette bilge switches ties to is not fully confirmed by measured net, only inferred from row proximity; flagged per the no-interpolation rule.
Sail Locker bilge valve status tap: no XA10/XA40 terminal number could be confirmed on the netlist for this zone (unlike the other four), so its monitoring destination is unconfirmed on this sheet.
